statement: The system shall ensure that only authorized prescribers can create and modify medication requests.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are auditable for compliance and security purposes.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are processed within 2 seconds for 95% of requests under a load of 50 concurrent prescribers.

statement: The system shall ensure that medication requests comply with regulatory requirements for prescription and refill management.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are protected from unauthorized disclosure.
The system shall allow prescribers to create a medication request that includes dosage instructions and dispense requests.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the number of refills allowed for a medication request.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the quantity and duration of the initial fill for a medication request.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the minimum period of time between dispenses for a medication request.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the time period for which a medication request is authorized.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the quantity of medication to supply per dispense in a medication request.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the expected number of days supply per dispense in a medication request.
The system shall allow prescribers to specify the intended dispenser for a medication request.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are encrypted when stored locally on end-user devices.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are protected from unauthorized access and modification.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are transmitted securely to the pharmacy.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are retained for at least 5 years as per regulatory requirements.
The system shall ensure that medication requests are protected from tampering.
